title: ux-recast documentation request
description: A request for a style guide, component specification sheets or a motion presentation. The three outputs are independent; motion needs a static sheet. Separate from review mode (D-07).

subject.description: What is documented, in the product's words.

basis.description: Documents the existing interface, an accepted redesign, or a proposal (C-38).

basis_reference.description: The decision or proposal an accepted or proposed output rests on.

motion.description: Refused without sheets or an existing sheet (C-47).

components.description: One sheet per component; required when sheets is true.

authority.description: An inspirational reference never overrides approved guidance (C-39).

out_dir.description: Where the validated guide and sheets are written, relative to the project.
